og_title: Roger Gracie: 10x World Champion BJJ Profile
description: Roger Gracie biography: 10x IBJJF World Champion, ADCC Absolute champion, signature techniques, and key matches.
intro_paragraphs: Roger Gracie is widely considered the greatest BJJ competitor in history.
His mastery of fundamentals — particularly the cross-collar choke from mount — is the gold standard.
He won 10 IBJJF World Championships including a record-tying 6 absolute titles.

sections.heading: Who Is Roger Gracie?
items: Born in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Trained at Gracie Barra under his father Mauricio Gomes and uncle Carlos Gracie Jr.

items.text: Considered the textbook execution. Pressure-based, methodical.
Tight, slow-pressure passing built on weight distribution.
Master at climbing to high mount and isolating an arm.

sections.heading: Training Background & Lineage
items: Direct lineage: Carlos Gracie → Helio Gracie → Mauricio Gomes → Roger Gracie.
Currently runs Roger Gracie Academy in London with affiliates worldwide.

faq.question: How many world titles did Roger Gracie win?
faq.answer: 10 IBJJF World Championships, including 6 absolute (open weight) titles.

faq.question: What is Roger Gracie's most famous technique?
faq.answer: The cross-collar choke from mount. He's been called "the king of the mount choke."
